summary.name: QuillBot
summary.one_liner: QuillBot is an AI writing and design suite for paraphrasing, grammar checking, tone analysis, and creating documents, presentations, resumes and social posts.
summary.what_it_does: The page presents QuillBot as a suite of AI tools for writing, designing and building content. It lists paraphrasing, grammar checking, tone analysis and fluency improvement as core writing functions. It also mentions creating presentations, resumes, social media posts and visuals, plus brainstorming through conversation and moving into Docs or Designs. It states it works across apps and websites, with a Chrome extension rated 4.5/5. Usage claims on the page include 35+ million writers and 140+ partner institutions.
notable: AI paraphrasing combined with grammar, tone and fluency checks
Document, presentation, resume and social post creation in one workspace
Chrome extension that works across websites and apps
Partnerships with institutions for students and teachers
caveats: Pricing tiers and feature limits are not detailed on the page
Page is mostly marketing claims and testimonials with few technical specifics
